facts.fact: PM-KISAN is for landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names, subject to exclusions (myScheme PM-KISAN page)
facts.quote: All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable land holding in their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.

facts.fact: Excluded: all serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government offices and their field units, PSEs, autonomous institutions and regular employees of local bodies, except Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees
facts.quote: All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/ State Government Ministries /Offices/Departments and its field units Central or State PSEs and Attached offices /Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular employees of the Local Bodies (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff /Class IV/Group D employees)

facts.fact: Excluded: all persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year
facts.quote: All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year

behaviour: Lists the published PM-KISAN eligibility and exclusion criteria (serving/retired government employees excluded except MTS/Class IV/Group D; income-tax payers excluded) with citation to pmkisan.gov.in; does not itself decide whether the user is eligible; gives the myScheme PM-KISAN eligibility link (myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pm-kisan).
fail_if: It gives a yes/no eligibility verdict, or omits the government-employee exclusion.
summary: Added base eligibility (myScheme) and the government-employee and income-tax exclusions as listed on pmkisan.gov.in.
